chain.title: Raid a Windy Garden
chain.desc: Small garden bushes generate in plains and savannas. Break one for a random crop - corn, onion, strawberry, lettuce, barley and more. Gardens are the ONLY natural source of this mod's 100 crops, so learn to spot them.

chain.title: Comb the Forest Floor
chain.desc: Shaded Gardens hide in forests and drop the kitchen-garden staples: tomato, garlic, leek, radish, sweet potato, tea leaves - and rarely a truffle. Fortune multiplies garden drops, so bring a good pick.

chain.title: Harvest the Cold
chain.desc: Frost Gardens grow in taiga and coniferous biomes: cabbage, cauliflower, peas, oats, rye, spinach and cotton. Cold biomes stop feeling barren once you know these are scattered through them.

chain.title: Wade the Swamp
chain.desc: Soggy Gardens sit in swamps and carry the water crops: rice, cattail, lotus, okra, cranberry, water chestnut. Rice alone makes this trip worth it - half the Extended cookbook wants it.

chain.title: Scour the Desert
chain.desc: Arid Gardens spawn in dry biomes with the survival crops: agave, cactus fruit, cassava, chickpea, lentil, papyrus and barrel cactus. Deserts quietly hold the mod's sugar and paper supply.

chain.title: Jungle and Sea Bounty
chain.desc: Tropical Gardens generate in jungles AND on the ocean floor: pineapple, coffee, ginger, soybean, kiwi, taro, sesame. Soybean and coffee are pack-wide favorites - grab every one you see.

chain.title: Corn in Hand
chain.desc: A typical windy-garden pull. Every crop item doubles as food and as crafting material - corn grinds into cornmeal for tortillas and cornbread in the Extended pack.

chain.title: Crop Becomes Seed
chain.desc: Any crop item crafts 1:1 into its seed - that is the whole domestication loop. One lucky garden find becomes an infinite farm; the seed replants like wheat on farmland.

chain.title: Farm Spiceleaf
chain.desc: From shaded and soggy gardens. Spiceleaf is the most-demanded seasoning in the Extended pack - sausage, chili, pizza, curry powder and dozens more call for it. Plant a full row early.

chain.title: Sugar Without Cane
chain.desc: Two agave craft into two sugar. A desert-garden agave farm out-produces sugarcane and feeds every candy, soda and dessert recipe across all the Pam mods.

chain.title: String from the Field
chain.desc: Two of any fiber crop - cotton, sisal, jute, flax - craft into string. No more spider hunting: wool, bows and scaffolding now come from your frost-garden cotton patch.

chain.title: Cattails Are Sticks
chain.desc: Two cattails give four sticks, and one cattail plus cooking oil makes a torch. A swamp-side cattail farm covers basic utility supplies without touching a tree.

chain.title: Grow Your Paper
chain.desc: Two papyrus (or kenaf) craft into two paper - books, maps and rockets without a sugarcane farm. Papyrus comes out of arid gardens.

chain.title: Water in the Waste
chain.desc: A barrel cactus plus an empty bucket yields a full water bucket. Farm a few in the desert and you carry emergency water, mud-making and potion supply as a crop.

chain.title: Slime from Aloe
chain.desc: Three aloe craft into a slimeball. Sticky pistons, leads and magma cream stop depending on swamp slimes the moment your tropical-garden aloe takes root.

chain.title: Gourds into Glass
chain.desc: Two calabash gourds craft into two glass bottles - a renewable, sand-free bottle supply for potions and the honey farm.

chain.title: The Oil Crop
chain.desc: Two canola on a roller press out FOUR cooking oil - double any other source. If you cook seriously from Food Core or Extended, a canola field is infrastructure.

chain.title: Roots in the Furnace
chain.desc: Sweet potato, taro, cassava, parsnip and six other root crops all smelt, smoke or campfire-cook into solid baked food. The lazy way to eat your garden surplus - no kitchen tools needed.

chain.title: Brew Hot Tea
chain.desc: Tea leaves from a shaded garden cook directly into hot tea in any furnace, smoker or campfire. A gentle reminder that this mod's drinks skip the kitchen entirely.

chain.title: Morning Coffee
chain.desc: Coffee beans from tropical gardens smelt into hot coffee. Farm the beans (bean crafts to seed like everything else) and breakfast is permanently solved.

chain.title: The Truffle
chain.desc: The rarest garden pull - one entry among seventeen in the shaded garden's loot table. It seeds like any crop, so a single find becomes a truffle farm. Consider it the mod's trophy.

notes: Verified against pamhc2crops-1.20-1.0.3.jar found in the a large test pack instance: 319 item/block lang keys; garden loot tables, worldgen features, forge biome_modifiers and all 177 recipes read directly. Six garden blocks are the sole natural entry point - biome_modifiers place windy in forge:is_plains/is_savanna, shaded in minecraft:is_forest, frost in forge:is_coniferous, soggy in forge:is_swamp, arid in forge:is_dry/overworld, tropical in minecraft:is_jungle AND minecraft:is_ocean. Each garden's block loot table rolls one random crop from its 12-19 entry pool (fortune adds bonus rolls). Every crop item crafts 1:1 into its <name>seeditem (97 seed items). Grains 3x craft into vanilla bread; utility conversions verified: 2 agave->2 sugar, 2 fiber->string, 2 paper_plants->2 paper, 3 aloe->slimeball, 2 calabash->2 bottles, barrelcactus+bucket->water bucket, cattail->sticks/torch, 2 canola+roller->4 pamhc2foodcore:cookingoilitem (the mod cross-registers recipes producing minecraft: and pamhc2foodcore: outputs). Baked roots and hot drinks are furnace/smoker/campfire recipes needing no kitchen tools. Truffle is a normal weight-1 entry in the shadedgarden pool - rare only by dilution.
